description: This PHP source file defines the class 'BaseHandler', which appears to be a utility class used within the SuiteCRM application. It handles setup tasks such as assigning language options and JavaScript code to templates, and provides protected methods to facilitate redirection and termination, likely aiding in request handling within the application.

classes.name: BaseHandler
classes.description: A utility class providing common setup and request handling functions for SuiteCRM, including language and JavaScript assignment, as well as protected methods for redirection and termination.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BaseHandler with Smarty template object, request data, and language strings; also initializes language and JavaScript settings.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Assigns language options to the template engine.

methods.name: getJavascipt
methods.description: Assigns JavaScript code to the template engine.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs HTTP redirection to specified URL; can be overridden for testing.

methods.name: protectedExit
methods.description: Terminates script execution; can be overridden for testing.

methods.name: protectedDie
methods.description: Terminates script with message; can be overridden for testing.
